title: Text Pipeline Construction: Visual Guide
outline: Title: Text Pipeline Construction: Visual Guide

1. From Features To Text | five ideas already taught in this course - feature pipelines, feature stores, point-in-time correctness and label leakage, training-serving skew, dataset versioning and snapshots - each tapped to light up the text-pipeline stage it becomes | the staging, versioning and rebuildability discipline is unchanged, only the raw material is messier, and each stage changes what downstream models can learn and retrieve

2. Parse Or Quarantine | four source formats with their extraction hazards, plus a failure-policy toggle and a slider over how many of 1,000 documents failed to parse | silently returning empty text looks exactly like a valid short document and passes downstream unnoticed, so failure must be explicit and empty rate plus extracted-to-source-size ratio must be measured

3. MinHash And SimHash | a 128-cell signature whose matching components estimate Jaccard (102/128 = 0.797), switchable to a 64-bit SimHash whose Hamming distance approximates angular similarity, with a shingle-size stepper | agreement between compact signatures estimates a real similarity measure without comparing documents, but neither proves semantic equivalence and containment is not symmetric

4. Bands And Rows | the all-pairs wall N*(N-1)/2 at three corpus sizes, then bands and rows dragged against a plotted S-curve of 1-(1-s^r)^b with markers at similarity 0.8 and 0.3 | banding creates an S-shaped threshold (20 bands of 5 rows gives about 0.9996 at 0.8 and about 0.0475 at 0.3); more bands buy recall and candidate volume, more rows buy selectivity and missed duplicates, and LSH only ever produces candidates

5. Funnel With Reasons | a quality threshold and a universal-versus-per-type policy applied to prose, chat, OCR, code and mathematics, feeding a five-stage funnel from 1,000,000 source records with a reason code per stage, plus a document-level versus section-level language ID toggle | one universal alphabetic-character threshold erases whole subcorpora while the headline number still looks fine, so thresholds vary by type, language ID is stored with confidence, and every removal carries a reason code
